description: Japanese tax appeal deadlines (国税通則法 第77条): request for reinvestigation or for review within 3 months from the day after learning of the disposition, review within 1 month after a reinvestigation decision, and no appeal after 1 year from the disposition without justifiable reason. Weekend ends move to the next weekday. Japan, as of 2026-11-21 (e-Gov current law and NTA Tax Answer). General information and estimates only; individual tax advice and return preparation are reserved to 税理士 (税理士法 第52条).

disposed.description: Date of the disposition, if different

noticed.description: Date you learned of the disposition (notice received)

reinvestigationDecided.description: Date the reinvestigation decision was received
